prerequisites: Nia has brought her unfinished kite
actions: Nia asks to borrow the string reel and explains why
consequences: The reel is lent for useful afternoon work; its ownership remains Tamsin's
prose_obligations: Establish Nia's wish to include Pavel
Make the loan and return expectation understandable

actions: Inspect and take the worn reel
consequences: Nia has custody, not ownership
prose_obligations: Keep the reel physically continuous and useful

actions: Select willow for a frame
consequences: Material strength influences flight
prose_obligations: Ground frame quality in workshop material

actions: Cross sticks, stretch paper, tie corners
consequences: A flyable kite exists
prose_obligations: Show a tangible construction action

actions: Notice the breeze
consequences: Wind strength affects the later attempt
prose_obligations: Do not present weather as a character choice

actions: Nia approaches Pavel without shouting
consequences: Both children and kite reach the flying field
prose_obligations: Respect Pavel's reserve

actions: Invite him and offer a small role
consequences: Pavel accepts and his comfort is recorded
prose_obligations: His participation is voluntary, not assumed

actions: Give Pavel time to answer
consequences: High shyness yields less initial comfort and can restrict reel-sharing
prose_obligations: No instant personality transformation

actions: Pavel chooses and ties a red ribbon
consequences: The kite gains a stability bonus and a visible tail
prose_obligations: A small choice belongs to Pavel

actions: Trade a short practice pull and learn a gentle release
consequences: Nia gains skill; Pavel gains comfort; the line handles a little better
prose_obligations: Practice is not a hidden flight or an omitted effect

prerequisites: Pavel is comfortable enough to accept
actions: Nia offers Pavel the spool
consequences: Pavel holds the borrowed reel and later can lead the shared flight
prose_obligations: Show a real transfer of custody and agency

prerequisites: The children have chosen their roles
actions: Nia keeps the reel; Pavel guides the kite tail
consequences: Pavel still has a chosen, meaningful task; a distinct guided-flight ending remains possible
prose_obligations: Do not treat inclusion as identical to holding the spool

prerequisites: Kite built, Pavel invited, and roles chosen
actions: Launch and pay out string
consequences: Wind, frame, ribbon, practice and reel wear determine whether it rises
prose_obligations: Resolve an enacted attempt, not a forecast

actions: Hold or ease the line as wind loads it
consequences: The physical test is reflected in the flight result
prose_obligations: No unsupported breakage or miraculous rescue

prerequisites: Frame and line meet the wind threshold
actions: Nia lifts; the chosen reel holder calls the release
consequences: Kite is aloft and string is paid out
prose_obligations: Credit the children's complementary actions

prerequisites: The frame or line is insufficient for the wind
actions: Children lower the kite gently
consequences: Kite remains recoverable; remaining string is still useful
prose_obligations: A failed flight still resolves emotionally

prerequisites: Pavel holds the reel and the kite gets aloft
actions: Bring kite home and return the reel
consequences: Shared flight; useful reel returned to Tamsin
prose_obligations: Pay off Pavel's actual agency

prerequisites: Nia holds the reel and Pavel guides the tail
actions: Bring kite home and return the reel
consequences: A guided flight, distinct from reel-sharing, is completed
prose_obligations: Credit Pavel's chosen role without claiming he held the spool

actions: Recover the kite and return the reel
consequences: Flight fails, but the borrowed reel remains useful and Pavel belongs in the afternoon
prose_obligations: Do not leave the ending as a conditional promise

actions: Wind the remaining string and return the reel
consequences: Custody ends; owner and object remain consistent
prose_obligations: Return usefulness, not just possession

consolidation_note: The twenty entries are reference encounters, not twenty executable scenes. Adjacent weather, launch, tug, flight and recovery beats consolidate into the local play in launch; opening and loan beats consolidate into workshop; the invitation and waiting beats consolidate into invite. Return_the_loan is enacted within each ending. The three outcomes remain separate executable IDs because their prerequisites and payoffs differ.
